Esta é uma Vaga Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) .

Buscamos profissionais com interesse em se desenvolver na área de Compliance/GRC, em um ambiente acolhedor, seguro e comprometido com a inclusão.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Sales Operations Analyst will be responsible for optimizing sales processes, providing analytical support, and managing sales tools to ensure that our sales organization meets its targets. This role requires a blend of proactive thinking, operational expertise, and excellent communication skills.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary contact and escalation point for the global Sales team for day-to-day sales operations needs.
  • Ensure due diligence is conducted on each new sales opportunity with proper analysis to ensure efficiencies prior to commencing the sales cycle.
  • Assist in clean up, maintenance, and enforcement of proper usage of CRM tool and ensure data accuracy and integrity within all internal systems.
  • Assist in managing the sales pipeline, coordinating and facilitating sales transactions.
  • Manage internal approval process of corporate contracts including calculation of deals’ as sold effective rates.
  • Coordination of internal approval process of corporate contracts including final documents review and summary set up in ticketing system (JIRA) and validation with necessary departments for contract approval
  • Work closely with Finance to provide oversight and execution of daily, weekly, and monthly reports, including pipeline management, sales analysis, win/loss analysis, and sales metrics.
  • Participate in qualification calls with the sales team and senior management and assist in capturing meeting notes and action items.
  • Help prepare presentations and materials for the global sales team as needed.

Qualifications:

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience
  • Strong understanding and experience in working in a global sales team or with a global sales team
  • Familiarity with any Sales Force automation tool
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools
  • Proven experience managing simultaneous multiple priorities
  • Ability to partner cross functionally throughout the company
  • Strong MS excel and PPT skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent communication skills in verbal and written English
  • Knowledge of business communication via emailing, presentations, conference meetings
  • Strong organizational and decision-making skills
  • University Degree required

atuar na melhoria de sistemas de crawling de sites e na criação e manutenção de sistemas

title: Desenvolvedor De Front-End Genexus
description:
Contexto do projeto

Você atuará na evolução e sustentação dos canais digitais de crédito (simulação, proposta, onboarding, acompanhamento de esteira) para linhas de crédito consignado/super crédito voltadas a servidores públicos e CLT. O foco é experiência do usuário, performance, segurança e conformidade (LGPD/OWASP) em um ambiente de squads ágeis e integrações com serviços internos (cadastro, propostas, análise de risco) e terceiros (antifraude, bureaus, biometria, assinatura digital).

Principais responsabilidades

Construção de interfaces web em GeneXus: desenvolvimento de Web Panels, WorkWith for Web (Patterns), Grids, Master Pages e Theme Classes, garantindo responsividade (mobile‑first) e acessibilidade (WCAG 2.1 AA).

Customização avançada de UI: criação/uso de User Controls e integração com CSS/JavaScript para componentes ricos (máscaras, gráficos, stepper de onboarding, upload inteligente de documentos).

Integrações:Consumo e orquestração de APIs REST/SOAP (GeneXus: Procedures, Data Providers, SDTs, Business Components) — e.G., simuladores, score, antifraude (Serasa/ClearSale), validação de vínculo e margem.

Tratamento de erros, idempotência, timeouts e retries com backoff para UX resiliente.

Segurança e conformidade:Autenticação/Autorização via GAM (GeneXus Access Manager) e SSO (OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect/SAML), gestão de perfis/papéis, proteção contra OWASP Top 10 (XSS, CSRF, Injeção, etc.).

LGPD: coleta mínima de dados, consentimento, ofuscação/máscara e retenção segura.

Qualidade e performance:Perfilagem de telas/processos (latência de grid/filtros), otimização de Data Providers, redução de round‑trips, paginação eficiente, cache quando aplicável e otimização de recursos estáticos.

Testes funcionais/regressão (priorizar automação onde viável) e critérios de aceite bem definidos.

Colaboração e versionamento:Organização de KB (Knowledge Base), ambientes (Dev/QA/Prod) e versionamento via GeneXus Server (GXserver);
revisão de mudanças (code reviews de objetos), branching/merging e governança de releases.

Entrega e operações: Preparar builds e deploy para o generator adotado (.NET ou Java) em IIS/Java App Server e pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).

Planejar e executar Reorganizations de banco com segurança e estratégia de rollback/blue‑green/canary quando aplicável.

Trabalho em time e produto: Colaboração com UX/UI, Produto, Risco, Operações e Compliance;
refino de backlog (UserStories), estimativas, Definition of Ready/Done, documentação de objetos e padrões.



Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência sólida com GeneXus (v. 17/18+) em desenvolvimento Web (Web Panels, WorkWith for Web, Patterns, Master Pages, Theme Classes).

Front‑end web: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsividade, performance e boas práticas de acessibilidade.

Customização com User Controls e integração JS/CSS em GeneXus.

Integração com APIs REST/SOAP, modelagem via SDTs/BCs/Data Providers, tratamento de erros/latência.

Segurança com GAM, SSO (OAuth2/OIDC/SAML), proteção contra XSS/CSRF e gestão segura de tokens/segredos.

Banco de dados (SQL Server/Oracle/PostgreSQL): noções de modelagem, índices e leitura de planos.

Práticas ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), Git/fluxos de revisão, CI/CD (ex.: Azure DevOps).


Diferenciais (nice to have)

Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro/consignado (esteiras de proposta, margem, CET, portabilidade).

Automação de testes de UI e testes de APIs;
monitoração (AppInsights/ELK) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).

Design System corporativo: criação/adoção via Theme Classes, tokens e guidelines;
Stencils/técnicas de padronização visual em GeneXus.

Noções de DevSecOps e hardening de aplicações web.

Indicadores de sucesso (KPIs/OKRs sugeridos)

Performance das principais telas (p95 <
1,5s após cache aquecido).

Conversão nas etapas de simulação → proposta → formalização.

Taxa de defeitos pós‑produção (severidade alta) e lead time de mudanças.

Aderência a padrões (acessibilidade, segurança) e cobertura de testes automatizados.

title: Sales Manager-Motion Control & Industrial Automation-Brazil
description:
We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager based in Brazil, responsible for expanding our automation business across Brazil and the entire South American region.

This includes building strong relationships with distributors, system integrators, OEMs, and industrial end users in key markets such as Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and others.


The ideal candidate understands LATAM’s industrial automation market, has experience dealing with regional distributors, and can operate independently to scale our PLC, HMI, servo, and motion control business.


Responsibilities

1. Regional Business Development Across South America


  • Develop and manage business opportunities in Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and other South American markets.
  • Establish strong relationships with industrial customers in key sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (offshore platforms, drilling systems, pump control, skid automation)
  • Mining (conveyors, crushers, hoisting systems, process automation)
  • Food Processing & Packaging (filling lines, bottling lines, labeling & sealing machines)
  • Robotics & Automation (robot OEMs, integrators, palletizing/packaging robots, AMRs/AGVs)
  • Identify automation upgrade projects, machine builder opportunities, and OEM/ODM potential.

2. Distributor & System Integrator Network Expansion

  • Recruit and evaluate partners in Brazil and across LATAM with strong technical capability and service teams.
  • Assess integrators serving the above industries (mining automation integrators, food packaging integrators, oilfield service SIs, robotics integrators).
  • Provide training on products, applications, and industry-specific solutions.
  • Jointly drive business opportunities, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
  • 3. Sales Management & Project Execution
  • Lead opportunity development from first contact to contract signing.
  • Prepare technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers tailored to industry requirements.
  • Track project progress (pilot runs, commissioning, FAT/SAT), coordinating with China-based engineering teams.
  • Oversee regional pricing strategy, inventory planning, and distributor sales performance.
  • 4. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
  • Analyze competition in motion control and PLC/HMI markets (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Omron, Delta, WEG, Bosch Rexroth).
  • Understand industry-specific requirements:
  • Oil & Gas → explosion protection, extreme environment reliability
  • Mining → heavy-duty servo/VFD, dust & vibration resistance
  • Food Packaging → high-speed motion control, hygiene requirements
  • Robotics → EtherCAT, CANopen, servo performance, safety functions
  • Provide structured feedback to HQ regarding product localization, certifications (INMETRO), and market gaps.
  • 5. Marketing, Events & Branding
  • Represent the company at major industrial exhibitions in LATAM (FEIMEC, FIEE, EXPOMAFE, EXPOMIN, Colombiatex, Expoagro).
  • Organize seminars, workshops, and roadshows with distributors.
  • Deploy demo units for partners and key customers across industries.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.
  • 5–10 years sales or business development experience in one or more of the following sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (onshore/offshore automation)
  • Mining & heavy industry automation
  • Food processing & packaging machinery
  • Robotics, motion control, and industrial automation
  • Strong understanding of LATAM’s industrial automation ecosystem (OEMs, integrators, distributors).
  • Proven track record managing regional distributors and large industrial accounts.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:

We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.G.,, job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine;
    you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau
description:
About Pinnacle Group

Pinnacle Group is a leading workforce and technology solutions provider delivering innovative, data-driven services to enterprise clients worldwide. We combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help organizations modernize systems, optimize performance, and unlock the value of their data. Our teams partner closely with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, impactful solutions. At Pinnacle Group, we foster collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable results.


Summary

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau who will serve as both a functional and technical partner to the business. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and designing robust Tableau dashboards using advanced calculations and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, business-focused, and capable of building scalable reporting solutions from scratch. This position requires strong stakeholder engagement skills and deep expertise in Tableau development.


Job Description

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and document reporting requirements, define success metrics, and establish actionable KPIs.
  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Tableau dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and advanced LOD expressions.
  • Translate business questions into scalable data models, visualizations, and performance-driven analytics solutions.
  • Create calculated fields, parameters, filters, and data blending solutions to support dynamic reporting needs.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance through efficient data modeling and query tuning.
  • Present findings and insights to business leaders, translating technical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously enhance reporting frameworks by identifying automation opportunities and implementing best practices in BI development.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong Tableau development expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience creating dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and LOD expressions.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into measurable KPIs and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and performance optimization techniques.
  • Ability to balance technical execution with business-facing communication and stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly influence business strategy and decision-making. We empower our employees to take ownership of their work while providing the support and resources needed for professional growth. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Joining our team means contributing to meaningful data-driven transformation while advancing your career in a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.


Instructions

Please answer the questions below, attach your resume and email your responses to the correct contacts as part of your application. Please email your resume and responses to: and


  1. Describe your experience building Tableau dashboards from scratch, including how many you have created, examples of complex calculations, LOD expressions you have implemented.
  2. How do you approach gathering business requirements and translating them into measurable KPIs?
  3. Please share anything else you would like us to know that highlights your strengths or sets you apart as a Business Intelligence Analyst specialized in Tableau dashboard creation.

title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
ZTE Is looking for Delivery Engineer (Quality & Safety by Design)

Role Overview

We are hiring a Delivery Engineer to act as the engineering reference for post-sales delivery execution in complex telecommunications infrastructure projects.

This is a hands-on, operational role , focused on engineering decision-making, delivery feasibility, execution quality, and safety embedded by design .

It is not a people-management role and not a pre-sales position .

The mission is to ensure that what was sold can be installed, integrated, commissioned, accepted, and operated successfully in real environments , right the first time .


Key Responsibilities

  • Validate, review, and approve provisional and definitive engineering designs (PPI, TSSR, PDI, FAM, As-Built), ensuring technical consistency across the full delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure delivery designs comply with customer engineering standards , contractual technical scope , vendor global guidelines , and real site constraints (space, power, grounding, access, structural conditions).
  • Act as the engineering reference for delivery feasibility , identifying gaps, risks, or assumptions that could impact execution, quality, cost, or schedule.
  • Define, validate, and approve the Engineering / Installation Bill of Materials (E-BOM) , ensuring completeness and technical adequacy for installation, integration, and commissioning activities.
  • Classify materials and requirements clearly as included , assumptions , or out-of-scope / change-required , supporting transparent scope control.
  • Validate the engineering quality of executed installations , ensuring alignment with approved designs, customer standards, and best engineering practices.
  • Review and approve installation quality and acceptance evidence , including photos, checklists, test results, quality reports, and as-built documentation.
  • Decide, from an engineering standpoint, on installation acceptance, required corrections, or rework , based on objective technical criteria.
  • Embed quality and safety as engineering premises (quality & safety by design ), ensuring designs and E-BOMs support safe and reliable execution.
  • Identify delivery, integration, and acceptance risks early, proposing engineering mitigations to prevent rework, delays, and SLA impact.
  • Act as the engineering focal point in customer design reviews, technical workshops, and acceptance discussions , representing delivery engineering interests.
  • Interface with HSE/EHS, Quality, PMO, Billing, Presales and Field teams from an engineering perspective, translating requirements into executable design and delivery decisions.
  • Support technical clarification, deviation analysis, and root-cause discussions related to delivery execution and installation quality.

This role does not perform field supervision and does not assume legal HSE responsibilities.


What This Role Is Not

  • Not pre-sales or solution definition
  • Not people management
  • Not field supervision or safety technician

This role drives engineering decisions , not day-to-day execution control.


Profile & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering , or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in telecommunications delivery engineering within vendor, operator, or system integrator environments.
  • Practical exposure to one or more domains: RAN, IP, Microwave, Optical, DCN .
  • Strong understanding of installation, integration, commissioning, and real-world execution constraints .
  • Postgraduate specialization in Occupational Safety, Risk Management, Quality, or Compliance
  • Working knowledge of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) relevant to telecom infrastructure projects, such as NR-1, NR-6, NR-7, NR-10, and NR-35.
  • Familiarity with occupational safety procedures and documentation (e.G., basic understanding of PT/APR concepts), from an engineering and feasibility perspective.
  • English – Mandatory (primary working language)
  • Portuguese – Fluent or Native
  • Mandarin – Desirable


Why This Role Matters

Because delivery success depends on engineering decisions made before problems reach the field .


This role ensures that:

  • delivery designs are executable in practice,
  • quality is built into engineering decisions,
  • safety is considered by design,
  • customer acceptance is predictable and auditable.


If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Executivo De Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de Valparaíso - GO


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S.
-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Sales & Operations Supervisor - Connectivity
description:
At Stellantis, we’re breaking with the past and have launched a new software organization built from the ground up. The Software Business Unit (SWBU) inside the Product Development Technology (PDT) was established in 2021 and brings an entirely new vision to the driving experience. Our mission is to design the most captivating experiences in Mobility, bringing “tomorrow’s” tech innovations closer to today, everyday. If you’re ready to help lead this automotive technology transformation, we want to hear from you.


Summary


The Sales & Operations Supervisor will lead the growth and management of digital subscription services for Stellantis brands across initially in Brazil, Argentina, and Chile. This role is unique as it requires a dual focus: driving commercial performance (conversion and retention of monthly/annual plans) and serving as the regional technical lead for the subscription management system (Zuora).


The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between sales targets and system execution, ensuring a seamless experience and a scalable subscription model.


Key Responsabilities


Commercial Strategy & Sales Management

· Revenue Growth: supervision of connected services sales funnel, focusing on conversion (non paid>
Paid subscriber) and paid subscribers base increasement.

· Retention & Churn Management: Monitoring main KPIs as Churn and Retention rate and implement strategies to reduce them and management of Lifetime Value (LTV) of customers in the South America region.

· Market Adaptation: Customize sales approaches and promotional offers to meet the specific economic and cultural nuances of the Brazilian, Argentinian, and Chilean markets.

· KPI Tracking: Monitor and report on renewal rates, subscriber growth and implement actions to improve main KPIs as take rate, retention and churn.


Subscription System Management (Zuora)

· System Ownership: Act as the primary administrator for the Zuora platform in the region.

· Development & Configuration: Build and maintain product catalogs, pricing models, and promotional codes within the system.

· Operations & Billing: Ensure the integrity of the recurring billing cycle, payment gateway integrations, and automated customer communications.

· Process Improvement: Identify and implement system optimizations to improve the user journey and operational efficiency.


Requirements and Qualifications


· Bachelor’s Degree: In Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.

· Subscription Expertise: Proven experience in the Subscription Economy (SaaS) with a focus on recurring revenue models and management of digital sales channels.

· System Knowledge: Functional knowledge of subscription management platforms is required (Zuora is highly preferred;
experience with Salesforce Billing or SAP Billing is a plus).

· Hands-on Approach: Ability to seamlessly transition between high-level sales strategy and technical system configuration.

· Ownership Mindset: Proactive in identifying system gaps or revenue opportunities before they escalate into issues.

· Leadership & Influence: Ability to lead cross-functional processes and influence stakeholders across different countries and departments.

· Resilience & Agility: Comfortable working in a fast-paced multinational environment undergoing constant technological transformation.

· English: Advanced/Fluent (for global reporting and technical system management).

· Spanish: Advanced (essential for managing Argentina and Chile operations).

· Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in data analysis (Excel, Power BI, or Tableau) to interpret subscription health metrics.

· Hybrid Profile: Ability to switch between a "Sales mindset" (results-oriented) and a "Technical mindset" (process and system-oriented).


At Stellantis, we evaluate candidates based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, ages, ethnicities, nationalities, religions, sexual orientations, and disabilities. Diverse teams will allow us to better respond to the emerging needs of our customers and take care of our future.


Come be a part of it!

title: Head Of Community
description:
Warmy.Io — Remote | Global | B2B SaaS | AI

Warmy is not building “a community.”

We are building the home of email deliverability on the internet.

If someone works in email — agencies, SDR leaders, founders, growth teams, ESPs — we want one natural place they belong.

That place is Warmy.

We’re looking for a builder. A connector. A natural networker.


Someone who can turn customers into advocates, strangers into members, and conversations into movements.

If you’ve ever thought: “I could build the HubSpot of deliverability communities” — this role is for you.

About Warmy

Warmy is a revolutionary AI-powered email deliverability platform helping companies land in the inbox, not spam. We serve customers worldwide and are scaling fast with a fully remote international team.

We move quickly. We care about impact. We measure results.

Your Mission

Build the largest and most trusted global community in email deliverability.

Not a Slack group.

Not a newsletter.

A real ecosystem where professionals learn, share, connect, and grow.


What You Will Build
  • A thriving private community (Slack / Circle / platform of your choice)
  • Programs that turn users into loyal advocates
  • Relationships with agencies, ESPs, and industry experts
  • Events, webinars, office hours, and meetups
  • Educational initiatives and certifications
  • Feedback loops between customers and product
  • Ambassador and partner programs
  • A sense of belonging around the Warmy brand

You will own the community vision from zero to global scale.


What You Will Do
  • Define and execute Warmy’s community strategy
  • Recruit and onboard high-value members
  • Create engagement systems and rituals
  • Launch and run events (virtual and in-person)
  • Work closely with marketing, product, and sales teams
  • Identify industry influencers and partnerships
  • Turn community insights into growth opportunities
  • Measure engagement, retention, and advocacy metrics
  • Be the public face of the community when needed\


Who You Are
  • 4+ years building or managing communities (SaaS, tech, or professional communities preferred)
  • Naturally social and relationship-driven
  • Comfortable speaking publicly and hosting events
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution skills
  • High ownership mentality
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — you create opportunities
  • You enjoy helping people succeed
  • You move fast and learn fast

If you love spreadsheets more than people, this is not your role.


KPIs That Matter

We are a KPI-driven company. Success will be measured by:

  • Community growth and active members
  • Engagement and participation rates
  • Customer retention and advocacy
  • Partner relationships created
  • Pipeline influenced by community
  • Brand authority in the industry


Why Join Warmy
  • Fully remote international team
  • Fast-growing AI SaaS company in scaling stage
  • High autonomy and ownership
  • Direct impact on company growth
  • Work closely with founder and leadership
  • Opportunity to build a category-defining ecosystem
  • Competitive compensation + performance incentives


The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

You might be a fit if:

  • You believe communities can change industries
  • You love connecting people
  • You enjoy building things from scratch
  • You are proactive and bold
  • You want to create something globally recognized


If you want to manage a forum — this is not the job.

If you want to build the center of an industry — let’s talk.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable businessteams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience withETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience withSiebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Senior Software (Typescript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a "doer" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive "doer" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Experiência no segmento alimentício

Vivência no canal indireto

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde;

Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Forte experiência em debug Java, análise de threads, gerenciamento de memória e tuning de performance

- Experiência prática com SQL e bancos de dados relacionais (RDBMS), preferencialmente Sybase ASE/IQ e DB2

- Experiência na escrita e análise de queries SQL complexas para troubleshooting e validação de dados

- Conhecimento em linguagens de script como Shell Script, Perl, Python ou JavaScript para automação e suporte operacional

- Experiência com análise de logs, processamento batch e agendadores de jobs

- Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão e pipelines de deploy

- Inglês avançado


Modelo de Trabalho:

- Ambiente de Application Management Services (AMS) / Suporte à Produção

- Pode ser necessário suporte em regime de plantão e disponibilidade flexível conforme necessidade do negócio


Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que combinam sólida expertise técnica em Java com mentalidade orientada a operações e que apreciam atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e críticos para o negócio.

Position Summary:


Our partner is a quantitative trading organization where live market data, low-latency systems, and proprietary models directly drive capital allocation decisions. As the platform continues to scale, the team is adding a senior engineer to own the real-time streaming ingestion systems that power live trading. You’ll build production-grade Go services that consume live WebSocket feeds, process and time-slice high-throughput market data, and deliver reliable inputs to a C-based trading engine running on AWS. The focus is demanding and meaningful: streaming reliability, automated failover, observability, and production debugging in a latency-sensitive environment where performance and correctness directly impact outcomes. If you enjoy building systems where milliseconds matter and your work influences real capital in motion, this is engineering at its sharpest.


Experience and Education:


  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience/field
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade distributed system for real-time or streaming environments
  • Strong production experience developing backend or systems services in Go
  • Experience implementing WebSocket-based live data ingestion
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, specifically EC2 and S3
  • Experience building and deploying containerized services, ideally in Kubernetes environments
  • Experience supporting low-latency, high-availability systems where downtime or delay had direct business impact


Skills and Strengths:


  • Go
  • Real-time streaming systems
  • WebSockets
  • Low-latency architecture
  • Production service development
  • AWS EC2
  • AWS S3
  • Kubernetes

  • High-throughput data processing

Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Rebuild and own the production-grade, real-time market data ingestion system end-to-end
  • Develop high-performance Go services that consume live market data over WebSockets
  • Process and manage high-throughput streaming data across approximately 1,500 equities
  • Aggregate and time-slice streaming data for accurate downstream model consumption
  • Deliver structured, low-latency data feeds to a C-based trading engine running on AWS EC2
  • Design and implement automatic failover from live market feeds to delayed backup streams

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.Com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.G. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Senior Carrier Business Development Executive
description:

title: Senior Api Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Headspace Health is the world’s most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively.

Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.


Role summary:

Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You’ll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.


Key responsibilities:

  • Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting.
  • Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks.
  • Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices.
  • Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality.
  • Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation.
  • Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards).
  • Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow.
  • Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility.
  • Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.


Required skills & experience:

  • 7+ years building production microservices and APIs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design.
  • Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems.
  • Hands-on development in TypeScript for backend services.
  • Proven RESTful API design and contract experience.
  • Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies.
  • Strong with AWS (API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents).
  • Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers).
  • Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification.
  • Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties.
  • Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.).
  • Good spoken English


Nice to have:

  • Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources.
  • Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts).
  • Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics.
  • Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos).
  • Background in personalization/experimentation systems.
  • Hands-on development in Python for backend services.


Hiring signals:

  • Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements.
  • Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns.
  • Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems.
  • Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.


Perks:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Health/Sport budget
  • Remote work
  • Flexible PTO
  • Global offices
  • Fun, positive, collaborative environment!



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Supply Chain Planner
description:
Senior Supply Planner

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil


Position Summary


We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Senior Supply Planner to support supply planning activities. This role is responsible for executing supply plans, managing inventory, and supporting cross-functional teams to ensure product availability and operational efficiency. While this position does not have direct reports, it plays a critical role in driving planning accuracy and supporting broader supply chain goals.


Key Responsibilities


  • Supply Plan Execution : Support the development and execution of supply plans aligned with demand forecasts and production schedules.
  • Purchasing : Develop and execution of ZFIN supply plans and purchase execution;
    manage communication with international suppliers
  • Inventory Management : Monitor inventory levels to ensure optimal stock availability while minimizing excess and obsolescence.
  • Capacity Coordination : Collaborate with manufacturing and procurement teams to ensure supply readiness and resolve capacity constraints.
  • Cross-functional Support : Work closely with brand, demand planning, procurement, and regional teams to align supply activities with business needs.
  • Innovation : Support innovation and product launch activities by aligning supply plans with new product introductions and timelines.
  • Portfolio Management : Oversee SKU lifecycle management, including product exits, dispositions, rework opportunities and both ZFIN / ZSAS material status to maintain accurate inventory profiles and product line alignment.
  • S&OP: Support successful execution of S&OP initiatives in Brazil by partnering with cross functional teams to ensure smooth execution of S&OP cycles
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Analyze supply chain data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. Prepare content and present to support decision-making within S&OP meetings.
  • Issue Resolution : Assist in resolving supply disruptions and delays, escalating issues as needed to maintain service levels.
  • Process Improvement : Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving planning processes, system utilization, and operational efficiency

Key Performance Metrics

  • Inventory Health: Ratio of productive vs. non-productive inventory.
  • Service Level Achievement: 95% of orders fulfilled on time
  • Supply Plan Adherence: 82% of planned orders executed within the scheduled month.
  • Capacity Utilization: Manufacturing capacity effectively used and prebuild requirements identified and monitored monthly
  • Portfolio Management: Achieve targeted YE Active SKU count, as well as, exiting identified SKUs by target date



Key Skills & Qualifications


  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, or related field.
  • Language Skills: Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and English required;
    Spanish is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in supply planning or related roles, preferably within a branded product environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Knowledgeable in advanced Microsoft Excel formulas and familiarity with ERP and planning systems (e.G., SAP, Kinaxis, Oracle).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Communication: Effective communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and organizational skills.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel up to 10% annually, potentially including international locations.


Career Development

As a Senior Supply Planner, you will have opportunities to expand your expertise in global supply chain operations, planning systems, and cross-functional collaboration. This role provides a strong foundation for advancement into managerial and strategic planning positions. You will gain exposure to brand-specific planning strategies, participate in process improvement initiatives, and develop skills that support long-term career growth within the organization.

title: Back-End Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A GoCache desenvolveu no Brasil uma plataforma de Web Security e CDN, estrategicamente distribuída em todas as regiões do país, que entrega segurança e alta performance para cerca de 300 clientes, incluindo Ultrafarma, Kenlo, Pura Vida, Flamengo, além de instituições do mercado financeiro e do governo.


Diariamente, 20 milhões de brasileiros consomem conteúdo de algum dos 150 mil websites e aplicações que utilizam nossa plataforma, reforçando nosso compromisso em proporcionar uma experiência digital de alta qualidade.

Com foco em garantir que as empresas prosperem no ambiente digital, a GoCache oferece defesa efetiva contra ameaças cibernéticas, assegurando uma experiência online segura e fluida para a audiência de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso vai além da proteção;
buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.


O desafio:

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

O trabalho é PJ, com flexibilidade de horários. Não esperamos plantões ou esforço fora do horário — mas, se você quiser acompanhar alguma operação ou rotina específica por curiosidade técnica, a porta está aberta.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas escaláveis e resilientes, sempre com foco em performance, segurança e simplicidade.
  • Desenvolver serviços backend (principalmente em Lua e Go) voltados à detecção de ameaças, antifraude e proteção de APIs.
  • Atuar na sustentação de sistemas críticos, investigando gargalos e propondo melhorias duradouras.
  • Elevar continuamente nossos padrões internos: testes, automações, CI/CD, observabilidade e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar e orientar pessoas do time, compartilhando conhecimento de forma clara e colaborativa.
  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Autonomia real para propor e construir soluções.
  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.
  • Desafios técnicos de verdade, impacto direto no produto e espaço para crescimento rápido.


Se você quer trabalhar em um time leve, colaborativo e altamente técnico, construindo soluções que protegem a web brasileira, vamos conversar.

title: Professor De Inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.
