title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!

title: Analista De Suporte A Compras Sênior (Paranaíba - Ms)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.




Sobre a Arauco Brasil



No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Desafio:

Garantir a execução das atividades do escopo da equipe de Suporte a Compras, como exemplo: elaboração e divulgação de políticas e procedimentos, cadastro e homologação de fornecedores, metas e indicadores de desempenho, orçamento, atendimento a auditorias, otimizando recursos, custos e assegurando a eficiência da equipe de Suprimentos e da Arauco Celulose Brasil.


Principais Atividades:


  • Elaborar e manter atualizadas políticas e procedimentos da área de Suprimentos, disseminando para os envolvidos, como compradores e clientes internos, assegurando a confiabilidade dos processos em linha com os objetivos e valores da Arauco Celulose Brasil;
  • Desenhar, implementar e manter processo de homologação de fornecedores, visando garantir que os fornecedores contratados estejam alinhados aos pré-requisitos e aptos para se relacionar com a Arauco Celulose Brasil.
  • Desenvolver, medir e disseminar indicadores de Suprimentos, como Prazo médio de Pagamento, SLA, Saving, dentre outros, monitorando a efetividade e eficácia dos planos de ação em caso de resultado abaixo do esperado;
  • Participar, incentivar e apoiar projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de sistemas e processos relacionados a Suprimentos, provendo os recursos necessários, visando a automatização de processos manuais, maior agilidade no atendimento às demandas das áreas, aumento da eficiência e acuracidade dos serviços prestados e otimização do custo operacional da estrutura;
  • Suportar no processo orçamentário da Arauco Celulose Brasil, apoiando na definição das premissas e no acompanhamento dos resultados da área de Suprimentos
  • Representar Suprimentos nas auditorias, quaisquer que sejam, de certificadoras, contábil, etc, sendo ponto focal da área no atendimento aos auditores, centralizando o envio das evidências solicitadas e acompanhamento dos eventuais planos de ação.
  • Administrar os custos da Gerência Executiva de Suprimentos, realizando acompanhamento mensal do realizado vs. Orçado.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos, Gestão Financeira, Logística, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas afins;
  • Pacote Office nível avançado;
  • Experiência e domínio do sistema SAP;
  • Experiencia coma ferramenta Power BI ou sistemas similares;
  • Experiência na criação, análise e interpretação de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs);
  • Domínio de matemática financeira, com foco em formação de custos, fluxo de caixa e análise de viabilidade de investimentos;

description:
About You

  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.

  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.Js/Ethers.Js;
    integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.G., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.G., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry);
    monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features;
    contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers;
    provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.G., Ethereum/Solana projects);
    proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred);
    crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills;
    ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

Atuará também na preparação e configuração de computadores, execução de backups, apoio em processos de formatação e recuperação de sistemas, além de contribuir com a documentação e controle de movimentações de equipamentos de TI e outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação da liderança.


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:

O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

- Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

- Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

- Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

- Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Oil & Gas Production And Revenue Accountant
description:
Position Mission

As a critical link between field operations and financial reporting, you will manage the full-cycle production and regulatory accounting for high-intensity shale assets. This role is designed for a technical accountant who excel in revenue accounting and using SAP PRA - specifically horizontal wells and multi-well pads-ensuring 100% compliance with Texas and Louisiana state mandates.


Operational Impact & Responsibilities

  • Basin-Specific Accounting: Execute monthly production accounting for operated/non-operated properties across the Permian, Eagle Ford, and Haynesville basins using SAP PRA.
  • SAP PRA Ownership: Maintain and update SAP PRA master data , including properties, wells, leases, and measurement points, and ownership and division of interest (DOI) data
  • Complex Allocation Management: Resolve production imbalances and ownership discrepancies related to unitization, pooling, and commingled production.
  • Regulatory Shield: Serve as the lead for Texas Railroad Commission (RRC) and Louisiana Department of Energy & Natural Resources (LDNR) submissions.
  • Audit Readiness: Manage regulatory master data and support audits, amendments, and inquiries.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner with Production Ops on volume validation, Land on DOI updates, and Marketing on price reconciliations.


Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated U.S. Onshore production accounting.
  • Education: University Degree in Accounting or Finance;
    CRC preferred.
  • Expertise: Direct history of managing Louisiana LDNR and Texas RRC frameworks.
  • SAP PRA mastery: Hands-on experience processing revenue adjustments and regulatory porting through the system
  • Agility: Ability to manage concurrent deadlines across multiple basins and state lines.
  • US Onshore Operations: Deep understanding of horizontal drilling and pad-based allocation scenarios.
  • Precision: High attention to detail regarding volume and regulatory data integrity.
  • Communication: Skilled at translating complex technical accounting data for non-technical stakeholders in Operations and Land.


Technical Requirements

  • SAP PRA (Master Data, Volume Management, Revenue Allocation)
  • Crawford Plus Packs (CPP) for State/Federal filings is a plus
  • SAP S/4HANA experience is highly valued
  • Advanced Excel for variance analysis and ad-hoc reporting

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de formaexaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Coordenador(A) Posto De Combustível
description:
Sobre a Empresa



O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos. Desde 2002,


A Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS);
painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR);
resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Sobre a Função



Coordenar as operações do posto de combustível, garantindo o cumprimento das metas operacionais, praticando segurança em todos os níveis de operação, garantindo a conformidade legal e a excelência no atendimento ao cliente interno, assegurando previsibilidade no estoque de produtos, organização e padrão de qualidade.



Responsabilidades



  • Coordenar as atividades operacionais do posto (pista, carregamento de comboio, descarga de combustíveis e áreas administrativas).
  • Gerenciar equipes de frentistas, manutenção e auxiliares, incluindo escala, desempenho, treinamentos e 5S.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e legislação vigente (ANP, NR’s, Corpo de Bombeiros).
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (Tempos de Descarregamento, Tempo de Abastecimento e FIFO de Estoque).
  • Criar procedimentos operacionais que contemplem todas as operações e riscos da área.
  • Coordenar recebimento de combustíveis, conferência de volumes e documentação fiscal.
  • Atuar na prevenção de fraudes, desvios e inconformidades operacionais.
  • Garantir o correto funcionamento dos equipamentos (bombas, tanques, sistemas de medição, sistemas de pagamento).
  • Implementar sistemas de gestão operacionais, interface com sistemas de gestão da empresa.
  • Elaborar relatórios operacionais e gerenciais para a gestão.
  • Atuar como elo entre a gerência, a equipe e fornecedores.
  • Ter rotina de monitoramento da relação com o fornecedor de produtos.
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, legislação trabalhista vigente, LGPD e políticas de Diversidade & Inclusão, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs.
  • Outras atividades correlatas à função.


Qualificações



  • Ensino Superior Completo em Logística, Administração, Economia, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável Especialização em Gestão de Custos, Supply Chain Management, Gestão de Projetos ou Equivalente ou áreas correlatas.


Habilidades Necessárias



  • Pacote office nível avançado.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de Gestão de Frotas.
  • Conhecimento da Sistemas de Telemetria.
  • Análise de Indicadores (KPIs).
  • Desejável conhecimento de SAP.

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).

title: Ai-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts
description:
HIRING: 2 AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts

We're Not a Startup. We're a $8M Company That Just Decided to Eat the Software Market.


Contract → Full-Time | Remote | 8 AM – 6 PM EST | Monday to Saturday - Start Immediately

First, Let's Talk About Why Your Current Gig Sucks

You already know this, but let's say it out loud:


1. You sit in meetings about meetings. Three hours of "alignment sessions" so six people can

approve a button color. Meanwhile, we ship entire features before lunch.


2. Your PRs rot in review queues for days. You wrote the code Monday. It's Thursday. Dave still hasn't looked at it. Dave is "swamped." Here? PR goes up, gets reviewed same day, ships same day.


3. You're a cog and you know it. You own a slice of a microservice that serves a widget inside a dashboard that nobody uses. Here, you own entire product surfaces end-to-end — UI, API, database, deployment. Your name is on it.


4. The "innovation" is a lie. They said "move fast and break things" in the job post. What they meant was "move at the speed of legal review and break nothing, ever, including your spirit." We actually move fast. Uncomfortably fast.


5. Your tools are chosen by committee. You're stuck on Jenkins pipelines from 2017 and a Jira board with 14 custom fields. We use Claude Code CLI, Linear, GitHub, Vercel, and that's about it. Clean. Fast. Done.


6. The tech debt is someone else's mess and now it's your problem. You inherited a codebase that looks like it was written by 47 different people across 3 continents over 6 years. Because it was. We're building from scratch with modern architecture and AI-first workflows.


7. You have zero ownership. You don't know the customers. You don't see the revenue. You don't feel the impact. Here, you'll watch real call center operators use what you built and hear them say "this changes everything." That's not marketing copy — that's Tuesday.


8. Your compensation is "competitive" (it's not). They gave you a 3% raise and called it generous. We do competitive salary + performance bonuses + profit sharing + PTO. You want to write your own ticket? Prove you're an A-player and the money follows.


9. Nobody cares how fast you are. You could ship 10x what your team does and you'd get the same review score as the person who refactored a README. We measure output: PRs merged, features shipped, products launched. Speed is the currency here.


10. You're building someone else's dream. Some VP's pet project. Some board member's "strategic initiative." Here, you're building products for an industry we've spent a decade mastering — and you get a real stake in the outcome.


Who We Are (And Why You Should Care)


I've spent 10 years building and owning call centers. Not advising them. Not consulting for them. Running them. We did $8 million last year in the call center world. We know every pain point, every inefficiency, every moment where operators think "there has to be a better way."

Now there is. We're pivoting to SaaS — and we're building the software suite that the entire call center industry has been waiting for. AI-powered call routing, real-time analytics, agent management, voice AI integration — the whole stack.


Our position is unfair and we like it that way:

  • We have deep domain expertise (10 years, $8M revenue, real operator relationships)
  • We have cash flow — we're not burning runway praying for product-market fit
  • We're raising capital to pour fuel on the fire, but we don't need it to survive
  • We're using Claude Code CLI to build at 5-10x the speed of traditional teams
  • We're bringing our first product to market right now , with a full suite behind it


Two developers + Claude Code + a founder who knows the industry cold = a team that outproduces companies with 10x the headcount. That's not theory. That's the plan.


The Role: What You'll Actually Do Every Day


You'll use Claude Code CLI as your primary development tool , running parallel sessions across git worktrees while maintaining production-quality standards. This isn't "use AI sometimes." This is AI-first development where you orchestrate multiple coding agents and own the output.


Daily work:

  • Build features end-to-end: UI → API → database → tests → deployment
  • Run 3–8 parallel Claude Code instances across worktrees
  • Write and maintain CLAUDE.Md project files and agent configurations
  • Decompose features into agent-executable specifications
  • Review, test, and refine AI-generated code for production readiness
  • Ship 2–4 PRs per day (yes, per day)
  • Record quick Loom demos of shipped features


Tech stack:

  • TypeScript (primary), Python (secondary)
  • Next.Js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Redis
  • Vapi / LiveKit for voice AI
  • Vercel + Supabase for deployment
  • Claude Code CLI — this is the job


Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years professional development experience
  • Deep Claude Code CLI proficiency — you should be able to show me your CLAUDE.Md from a real project
  • Strong TypeScript + Python
  • React / Next.Js production experience
  • PostgreSQL and data modeling chops
  • Git mastery: rebasing, worktrees, bisect, clean history — not just commit and push
  • Test-driven development habits
  • Excellent written English


Work Setup (No Exceptions):

  • High-end computer — your machine needs to handle multiple Claude Code instances, local dev servers, and Docker without breaking a sweat. If your laptop fans sound like a jet engine opening VS Code, this isn't the gig.
  • High-end internet — stable, fast connection. You're screen-sharing, pushing code, and running cloud deploys all day. Laggy internet = laggy output.
  • Available 8 AM – 6 PM EST, Monday –Saturday — 10-hour days. We work hard. I work 80-hour weeks. I'm asking you for 60. That's the deal.
  • Reliability is everything — show up, communicate, deliver. Every day. No disappearing acts.


Communication is IMPERATIVE:


This cannot be overstated. You need to be a clear, proactive communicator. Daily async standups. Responsive on Slack. Articulate in PRs. If something's blocked, you say so immediately — not two days later. We're a small, fast team. Communication gaps don't just slow us down, they kill momentum.


The Transparency Section

We use time tracking software. Not because we're micromanagers — because we're building trust with accountability. Honest work gets honest pay. Simple.


You work 10-hour days. Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM EST. This is a high-intensity, high-output role. We're bringing a product to market and building a suite behind it. If you want work-life balance right now, I respect that, but this isn't the role. If you want to build something massive and get rewarded for it, keep reading.


We move at startup speed with real-company cash. That means you get the excitement of building from zero without the anxiety of wondering if payroll clears next month.

What You Get


Competitive salary — real money, not "equity only"

Performance bonuses — ship fast, get paid more. Directly tied to output.

Profit sharing — we win, you win. Not a poster on the wall. Real checks.

️ Paid time off — because burned-out developers write burned-out code

title: Analista De Desenvolvimento Analítico Sr
description:
Venha fazer parte da Nação Azul!


Objetivo da posição : Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas para novos produtos e produtos já existentes no portfólio, utilizando técnicas analíticas de acordo com as legislações vigentes.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e validar métodos analíticos de alta complexidade para produtos terminados, matérias-primas, resíduos de limpeza, para suporte nos processos de controle da qualidade, validação de processos, validação de limpeza, estudos de estabilidade, desenvolvimento de produtos e outros, referenciando-se em normas locais e regulatórias, corporativas, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Realizar e avaliar análises físico-químico em matérias-primas, produtos pilotos, produtos acabados, produtos em processo, água, preenchendo os registros de análise, laudos, solicitações de análise, registros de uso de equipamentos e logbooks;
  • Pesquisar, desenvolver e validar métodos analíticos para doseamento, uniformidade de conteúdo, dissolução, produtos de degradação, de acordo com as legislações vigentes, através de técnicas analíticas como Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (CLAE/ UPLC) Cromatografia Gasosa (CG) e Headspace (CG- HS), Espectrômetro Ultravioleta e Visível (UV – VIS) e outras técnicas;
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos operacionais padrão, manuais técnicos, especificações de requerimento de usuário, especificações técnicas, especificações e métodos analíticos e outros documentos;
  • Elaborar e revisar protocolos e relatórios de validação conferindo os dados sequenciais para que seja de fácil entendimento e execução;
  • Fazer o levantamento das necessidades de compras de materiais para o desenvolvimento dos estudos analíticos, realizando e levantamento de informações técnicas do produto junto aos fornecedores.

Ensino superior completo em Farmácia, Química ou Engª Química;

Mandatórios:

Desenvolvimento de métodos analíticos por Cromatografia;

Conhecimento em legislações vigentes: validação, degradação forçada, controle de impurezas (ICH Q3A a D / ICH M7), Nitrosaminas, extraíveis e lixiviáveis;

Experiência com desenvolvimento analítico, fluxos e requisitos analíticos para registro de medicamentos/suplementos veterinários (MAPA);

title: Pessoa Coordenadora Segurança Da Informação
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra.


Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 160 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.



Objetivo:

Responsável pelo acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades segurança da informação, disponibilizando ferramentas e auditando a utilização da mesma bem como assegurando, visando garantir a confidencialidade, integridade e disponibilidade dos sistemas e plataformas da empresa, dos parceiros e clientes, aumentando a eficiência operacional de forma segura, em conformidade com as normas e procedimentos da empresa. Criar filas de atendimentos e orientar o time a colocar o cliente no centro, priorizando o atendimento e a satisfação do cliente, sem deixar de seguir as regras de negócios e critérios de liberação de acesso. Auditar os acessos de administrador visando maior segurança e garantir a disponibilidade das ferramentas que liberam os acessos.


Atividades:

  • Coordenar equipe multidisciplinar para demandas de gestão de acesso e GRC SAP, atendimento de chamados e demandas de Segurança da Informação, sendo Blue e Red Team, garantindo o atendimento dentro dos prazos acordados, colocando o cliente no centro, priorizando a qualidade, agilidade e segurança nas liberações de acesso aos ambientes, ferramentas e sistemas do grupo.
  • Garantir a aplicação de princípios de segurança da informação, por meio da avaliação dos processos de tecnologia da informação.
  • Gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades, Firewall, IPS, Antivírus, EDR, AntiSpam, SIEM, WAF, Filtro de conteúdo Web, Cofre de Senha, HoneyPot, Threat Intelligence, Segurança em Nuvem, Forense, liberação de acesso para auditoria de Compliance e novas tecnologias.
  • Atuar na garantia da segurança de dados do ERP SAP e SAP HANA Cloud, validando a robustez do ambiente nativo e providenciando um ambiente protegido contra ameaças.
  • Conhecer arquitetura de centralização de repositórios de armazenamento, protegendo grandes quantidade de dados processados dos tipos estruturados, semiestruturados e desestruturados, Data Lake, para que seja possível prover segurança ao ambiente.
  • Proteger o ambiente tecnológico por meio do entendimento e aplicação de conceitos e metodologias de modelagem de ameaças cibernéticas.
  • Promover, sistematicamente, melhoria contínua, através da consolidação, monitoramento e análise dos indicadores de performance de segurança, bem como da elaboração de planos de ação, também é necessário criar indicadores de performance e monitoramento do ambiente.



Requisitos Mínimos:


  • Pós Graduação: Gestão de Segurança da Informação / Governança de TI / Gestão de Projetos / Sistemas de informação / Ciência da Computação
  • Conhecimentos e atuação nos conceitos/processos de segurança da informação:
  • OWASP, NIST, CIS, ISO27000;
  • Certificações desejáveis: Cobit, ITIL, ISFS – Information Seurity Foundation ou ISO 27001, PDPF – Privacy & Data Protection Foundation, AWS Security, Azure Security, CISSP, CISM;
  • Experiencia em gestão de projetos de segurança da informação;
  • Conhecimento emarquitetura de redes.

title: Ruby On Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 5 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You

  • You’re a full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years of experience.
  • You’re a product-minded engineer with a pragmatic approach to building software.
  • You write expressive readable and maintainable code instead of just hacking together something that only works.
  • You’re curious about IoT, WiFi and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.
  • You want to learn how a business operates and get exposure beyond just writing code.


About the Role

  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, Javascript and deploy it via Heroku.
  • Work with the CTO to break down large projects into small shippable slices and execute on those projects.
  • Build API integrations with 3rd party software providers
  • Create intelligent scripts and integrations to automate WiFi management tasks
  • Create and review pull requests in Github.


Why Work at StayFi?

  • You’ll be working directly with the CTO and CEO on mission critical projects.
  • You’ll get mentorship directly from the CTO and senior engineers who can help you go from being a junior or mid-level engineer to being a true master.
  • As you continue to do good work and help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to learn the ins and outs of running a sustainable and growing business.
  • You’ll be working on a small team, so you’ll get the chance to have a large impact within our company and in the vacation rental industry at large.


Location

  • Join our fully remote team from anywhere in the world. We hire globally and currently have a strong presence in the US, Latin America (Argentina, Brazil, Colombia), Europe (Netherlands, Portugal, Romania), and Africa (Egypt, Nigeria). We are looking for the best talent, regardless of geography.

title: Aws Devops Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.


You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud , including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure , primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us;
you will regularly havean outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

description:

Status: Full-time/Contract

Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia

  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus

  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.Js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.Js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

You bring strong CM fundamentals:

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code;
you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.Js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Job Description


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Daily Responsibilities:

  • Track and trace e-Commerce shipments in North America (sales, returns, trade-ins, replacements) to identify possible delays and create action to troubleshoot (only when needed).

  • Update, automate (with help of other Google teams) and monitor centralized KPI boards.
  • Resolve escalations from customers and/or internal stakeholders regarding shipment status all the way until resolution by collaborating with Transportation carriers and other Google teams/functions (customer support, Fulfillment, 3PL).
  • Support Google Transportation Operations Manager in transportation master data configurations and troubleshooting.
  • Support Transportation requirements for ongoing cross functional Projects.


Mandatory Skills/Qualifications:

  • Transportation experience, or warehouse experience. (preferably in parcel transportation)
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving experience, combined with strong business judgment and an ability to present analysis in a clear and compelling manner;
  • Able to navigate ambiguity in work to find issues and work with the appropriate teams to fix/find a solution. ability to follow up with cross functional teams.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to work under tight deadlines and with a sense of urgency.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.


Required to work in the US PST time zone.


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee– our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and teambuilding activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Aws Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Calypso Configuration And Environment Management
description:
